title: Fastlane Onboarding Visual Playkit — auth, keys, streaming & toolcall previews
creator: Priya Nair
description: Design a compact, reusable visual playkit for API/SDK quickstart docs that demonstrates auth flows (API key creation & rotation), streaming responses (token-by-token), and tool-calling interactions. Deliverables: annotated static screenshots, 3 short GIFs (auth flow, streaming live preview, tool-call lifecycle), a Lottie micro-animation for streaming cursor, and a CodeOverlay component with masked keys for snippet screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: One set of annotated static screenshots per flow: Auth (key create/rotate), Streaming (initial streaming, mid-stream partial output, streaming error fallback), Toolcall (request -> tool execution -> structured response)
3 GIFs (<=5s) optimized for docs CDN: auth-key-creation.gif, streaming-live-preview.gif, toolcall-lifecycle.gif
One Lottie animation (~300KB) to indicate streaming token arrival usable in web docs
CodeOverlay component supporting masked keys and copy-to-clipboard states in PNG exports
Figma file with component instances and tokens; handoff notes for engineering (assets + export specs)
user_flows: Auth-first-run: sign-up -> create API key modal -> copy & store -> rotate key preview
Streaming-embed: SDK init -> stream start -> token-by-token UI -> streaming completion with tokens shown
Toolcall-demo: schema definition -> tool selection -> tool call triggered -> structured JSON response displayed and downloadable
visual_variants: Full-width hero strip for release notes page (1200x360)
Inline inline-snippet overlay for SDK docs (max 680px width)
screenshot_requirements: All PNG exports must have 2x retina scale and include bounding box of component
Mask API keys using CodeOverlay component (show last 4 chars) and add tooltip 'Key truncated for security'
Stream screenshots must include progress indicator and timestamp (ISO) in bottom-right corner
Toolcall screenshots should show the tool name, request payload (summary), and final JSON result collapsed by default
